sources.credit: Mayk Wendt / Our Heritage, reference only.
sources.observation: The three eastern apses have distinctly pitched roofs. The warm stone openwork bell tower carries a clock, the white stepped-gable Planta Tower stands beside the nave, and the small Holy Cross Chapel is separate.

limitations: Convent roof divisions and small façade details are photo-based approximations. The cemetery and most grounds remain map context. The model covers the exterior.
